upstream.description: Open-source native macOS HTTP debugging proxy — intercept HTTPS, inspect APIs, mock responses, debug WebSocket & GraphQL. Community-driven. For developers, by developers.

classification.analysis: Rockxy is a native macOS Swift application that acts as an HTTP/HTTPS/WebSocket/GraphQL debugging proxy, positioned as an open-source (AGPL Community edition) alternative to Proxyman and Charles Proxy. It offers traffic capture and inspection, advanced filtering, TLS certificate management, map-local/map-remote, block/bypass lists, a built-in AI assistant (local analysis plus optional Ollama or cloud providers) for investigating captured traffic, and a local MCP server exposing ten read-only tools so Claude Desktop or Cursor can query captured traffic directly. It targets iOS/API/backend developers debugging network traffic on a Mac who want a trustworthy, inspectable, locally-run proxy tool.

use_cases.title: Intercept and inspect HTTPS traffic from an iOS app or Mac process
Ask an AI assistant to explain why a captured API call failed
Query captured network traffic from Claude Desktop or Cursor via MCP
Mock or redirect a flaky third-party API with Map Local/Map Remote
